csv_project_name: Db Svc for FY26 National Roofing Program
csv_scope_of_work: The Scope of Work (SOW) is for the design and construction services required to repair failed or failing roofs in the United States Army Reserve Command (USARC) roofing inventory under the NRP FY25 Project 11 Design-Build Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC) for Building Envelope, Roof Repair and Replacement Construction in Support of the U.S. Army Reserves National Roofing Program (NRP), Army, and Air Force Reserve Sections.

title: Design-Build Services for FY26 National Roofing Program
short_description: Design-build roof repair and replacement services for Army Reserve facilities in Montgomery, Alabama.
project_scope: Design and construction services to repair failed or failing roofs within the United States Army Reserve Command roofing inventory under the National Roofing Program FY25 Project 11 Design-Build MATOC for building envelope, roof repair, and replacement construction supporting Army and Air Force Reserve sections. No building sizes, roof areas, or technical span data are stated.
services: Design-build services for building envelope works, roof repair, and roof replacement construction.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a roofing and building envelope repair program, not a structural or special structure project.
- No bridge, long-span roof structure, stadium, or architecturally demanding building scope is described.
- Tender is for construction/design-build execution rather than structural design of complex load-bearing systems.
- Falls outside sbp's core target areas and resembles general building maintenance.
construction_cost_explanation: Estimated from the tender-stated total construction cost range of $1.0M-$5.0M; midpoint used as a plain-number estimate in USD.
fee_explanation: No explicit planning fee is stated. The notice only indicates a design-build procurement for roof repair and replacement under a MATOC; no separate engineering fee basis is provided.
